Naked,Ⓒa.Ⓓnagna, vivastra, nir or a-vastra or vasana, vivasana, vivAsas, aparicCanna, digvAsas, digaMbara, vastra or vasana-hIna-rahita-SUnya; vivfta, anAvfta, anAcCAdita.
Ⓑ
 2 asajja, asaMbadDa, aBUzita.
Ⓑ
 3 kevala, anAvfta, SudDa, mAtra in comp.
Ⓑ
 4 spazwa, suprakASa, sPuwa; ‘by the n(aked) eye’ netramAtreRa; ‘a n(aked) woman’ nagnA, kowavI; ‘he would not have left me n(aked) to my enemies’ SatruprahAravaSaM-SatruvaSA-yattaM-mAM nAkarizyat.
Ⓝ[Naked]ly,Ⓒadv.Ⓓnagnavat, apa-ricCannaM; kevalaM, spazwaM.
Ⓝ[Naked]ness,Ⓒs.ⒹnagnatA, nagna-BAvaH; anAvftatvaM.
